title: React Bits component index

rights.storage: metadata, KINETIC-authored analysis, and internal comparison screenshots only
rights.terms_status: UNVERIFIED; public observation remains limited to the audited abstract-reference boundary

browser.capture_scale: resized internal comparison copy at 720px maximum width

desktop_initial.structure: Dark three-zone application shell: persistent top bar, grouped left navigation/filter rail, dominant central browse surface, and a narrower right support rail.
desktop_initial.visual: Large browse heading and compact controls lead into a repeated multi-column gallery of rounded preview panels with small metadata strips.
desktop_initial.interaction: Search, preferences/theme controls, category filtering, active navigation state, and card affordances are visible.

desktop_mid_scroll.structure: Left rail remains independently navigational while the center shows successive card bands; the right rail keeps promotional/support blocks vertically separated.
desktop_mid_scroll.visual: Even gutters, rounded dark panels, muted borders, and concentrated violet/magenta/blue gradients keep a dense catalogue legible.
desktop_mid_scroll.interaction: Preview treatments imply glow, blur, distortion, and hover-ready states without a claim about their exact timing or implementation.

desktop_final.structure: The gallery ends with a final card row and breathing room; there is no conventional full-width footer, while support panels remain in the side rail.
desktop_final.visual: A small return-to-top affordance closes the browse flow; the shell remains compartmentalized rather than becoming a new editorial section.
desktop_final.responsive_note: The wide arrangement implies rail collapse/drawer behavior and fewer card columns on small screens; mobile behavior was not directly captured.

visual_analysis.desktop_initial: A dark documentation/gallery shell prioritizes browsing: top utility bar, left grouped rail, central multi-column shelf, and right support panels. A bold heading and compact search/filter controls establish hierarchy before the previews.
visual_analysis.desktop_mid_scroll: Repeated card bands preserve an even browse rhythm. Rounded frames and low-contrast borders contain varied abstract motion treatments; saturated gradients stay localized to previews and calls to action.
visual_analysis.desktop_final: The catalogue resolves with a final card row and return affordance instead of a conventional footer. Support content stays in the side rail, preserving the center as the primary browse task.
visual_analysis.evidence_limit: One-off desktop visual observations do not establish source timing, easing, hidden implementation, mobile behavior, or permission for code/assets/training reuse.

limitations: Manual one-off observation only; no automated source capture or corpus ingestion.
Screenshots are internal comparison evidence and are not reusable source assets.
Only desktop states were captured by the available browser surface; mobile remains unresolved for human fidelity review.
